about_intro: A small, open project. It belongs to nobody, so that everybody can use it.
about_meta_description: Who maintains the Home-Mandate Specification, the principles of this open standard for AI agents in the smart home, how changes happen and how to join.
about_02_1_body: No vendor decides alone. Every implementation is treated the same.
about_02_2_body: A mandate must be understandable without technical knowledge.
about_02_4_body: Text, code and discussions are public.
about_maintainer_text: The specification is maintained by Markus Mazurczak as maintainer. He looks after the text, the conformance cases and the releases. Decisions are made in public in the [Home-Mandate organisation on GitHub](https://github.com/home-mandate), where anyone can propose changes. The project still belongs to nobody.
about_04_1_body: Someone describes a problem or idea.
about_04_2_body: A change to the text is proposed and discussed.
about_04_3_body: Conformance cases show the new behaviour.
about_06_1_body: Discuss issues and propose changes on GitHub.
about_06_2_body: Help bring this site to your language.
about_06_3_body: Build a guard, an integration or a tool.
